summary: Iteration 19 Admin Panel MVP Phase 1 — BOTH backend (17/17 pytest) and frontend (T14-T19) pass end-to-end. Backend: admin login (super_admin), 401 on wrong creds, 429 after 5 failures on unique email (seeded admin protected), /me returns admin profile, /me returns 403 with customer JWT and 401 without token, /dashboard?range=30d returns full kpis (total_customers=100, total_merchants=41, total_deals=29, active_deals=9) with kpis.today.{new_customers,new_merchants,new_deals} and charts.{deals_by_category,merchants_by_city,growth}. Merchants list with limit=5 respects pagination, includes active_deals/total_deals enrichment, strips password_hash/otp_code. PATCH merchants/{id}/status {status:'active'} returns ok:true and sets verification_status='approved'. Deals list?status=active correctly filters expires_at>now AND status!=archived. PATCH deals/{id}/status {status:'featured'} sets featured=true. Customers list strips secrets. PATCH customers/{id}/status {status:'blocked'} persists. audit_log collection has rows (verified via Motor: customer status:blocked TEST_iter19, merchant status:active TEST_iter19, merchant status:active TEST_iter19_audit). Regression: GET /api/deals still 200 with ≥1 item. Frontend (Chromium 1280x800 on preview URL): /admin redirects to /admin/sign-in when no token; seeded creds admin@happyhour.local / HappyAdmin@2026 log in to /admin dashboard with all KPI cards + charts (deals by category, top cities, signups); nav-merchants shows list with row-<id> testIDs; clicking a row loads merchant detail with admin-actions-card + Approve/Reject/Suspend/Deactivate buttons (added testIDs action-active/action-rejected/action-suspended/action-inactive during test to enable e2e assertion — MINOR TEST-ENABLEMENT FIX ONLY, non-functional); Approve tap succeeds; Sign out clears hh_admin_token from localStorage and redirects back to /admin/sign-in. Console warnings 'shadow* deprecated' and 'pointerEvents deprecated' still fire (pre-existing cosmetic RN-web deprecations tracked from iteration 17).

react_native_issues.issue: Console spams 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' on admin screens (from src/theme shadow.card). Cosmetic on web today. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow tokens) — same finding as iteration 17, still unaddressed.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' still logged. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx (same as iteration 17).

action_items: OPTIONAL polish: In AdminDetail web branch, replace global window.prompt() for required-reason actions (reject/suspend) with a proper modal so the flow works consistently on both web + native. Current prompt fallback works on Chromium but is not styled and can be blocked by browser prompt disable policies.

OPTIONAL: migrate theme shadow tokens to boxShadow style and change `<View ... pointerEvents='none'>` to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` to silence RN-web deprecation warnings (carried over from iteration 17).
critical_code_review_comments: admin_panel.wire_admin_router pattern uses app.dependency_overrides[require_admin] = _impl at wiring time — clever, but a source of surprise. Consider making require_admin a real dependency that reads a global getter at call time instead of overrides. Current impl works fine as long as wire_admin_router is called exactly once at startup.

Brute-force protection is in-memory (module-level _failed dict). Fine for single-process, but will not stop attacks in a multi-worker/multi-pod deployment. For production, back this by Redis or Mongo with TTL.
admin_login constant-time-ish path (`verify_password(pwd, '$2b$12$'+'a'*53)`) protects against user-enumeration timing — good.
All admin mutation routes correctly write audit_log rows with id, admin_id, entity_type, entity_id, action, reason, at (ISO). Verified 3 rows present after the test run.
Sensitive projections OK: users queries use {password_hash:0, otp_code:0}; merchant detail uses same for owner. No leaks observed in any response.

Deal 'active' filter uses `expires_at > now AND status != archived` — matches spec. Note: does not exclude 'paused' status; if pause should hide from active list, add {status:{$nin:['archived','paused']}}.
list endpoints correctly clamp limit to [1, 50].
